root_cause_of_the_new_blocker.ground_truth: The quote is verbatim, byte-for-byte present in the candidate README's Quick Start section, as the lead-in sentence for example:002 (SUPPORTED, executed exit 0). example:001 (CONTRADICTED, FileExistsError) is correctly and silently omitted - exactly what the contract requires. The content_units.json unit that actually authored this quote (section quick_start, slot lead_in) cites fact_ids ['example:002'] ONLY - it never cites example:001 at all. BC-04 (every unit cites existing SUPPORTED facts) already PASSED on this unit. The finding's own text and repair fields explicitly concede the composition is correct and nothing should change.
root_cause_of_the_new_blocker.why_it_still_blocked: review.py's factuality_defect (lines 238-298) computes `cited` from the FINDING's own self-reported fact_ids (line 274: `finding.get('fact_ids', [])`), not from the reviewed unit's own citations. Because the second reader padded its own fact_ids with example:001 (CONTRADICTED) purely as context for why no creation example is shown, `product` at line 282 includes both example:001 and example:002, and the short-circuit at line 289 (`if any(fact.polarity == 'CONTRADICTED' for fact in product): return None`) fires and leaves the finding standing - even though the fact that actually backs the quote (example:002) is SUPPORTED, and the reviewed unit itself never cited the CONTRADICTED fact at all. `_reviewed_unit_fact_ids` (added by G4-W17 item 83, 7ea9c38) already exists and is already threaded into this same function at line 291, but only to widen the SUPPORTED-literal refutation path (`reviewed = [...]` feeding `_cited_literal`) - the CONTRADICTED-stands gate at line 289 was never scoped to it, so a reviewer can still make an otherwise-correct, unit-grounded, SUPPORTED-backed claim block indefinitely by citing an unrelated CONTRADICTED fact of its own choosing alongside it. `excluded_evidence_defect` (line 884) and `absence_defect` cannot catch this either: both key off the finding's `absent` list (line 916: `if _claimed_absent(finding):`), which this finding left empty - the model expressed the omission-justification through `fact_ids`, not `absent`, so no existing refutation path ever runs on it.
root_cause_of_the_new_blocker.repair_loop_behaviour: targeted_repair correctly refused to manufacture a change (repairs.json attempt 2a6670181e3e53536c97f875: 'revised_output: matches the causal stage's own output unchanged; a no-op cannot repair a defect this stage's content did not change' - the aee8d5d guard working exactly as designed), then the finding re-raised identically on the re-check. The composition is permanently unrepairable through no fault of the authoring unit - the defect is entirely upstream, in review's own fold logic, matching the E4/item-78 shape (a permanently unrepairable finding with a code-expressible cause) but in review.py rather than registry.py.

proposal.file: src/repository_presenter/components/readme/review/independent/review.py, factuality_defect, lines 238-298 (the CONTRADICTED short-circuit at lines 289-290)
proposal.proposed_shape: Scope the CONTRADICTED-stands short-circuit to CONTRADICTED facts the REVIEWED UNIT itself cited (unit_fact_ids), the same source item 83 already threads into this function's SUPPORTED-literal path two lines below (line 291) - not the finding's own self-reported fact_ids alone. Concretely: a cited CONTRADICTED fact keeps a factuality finding standing only when that fact's id is also in unit_fact_ids (i.e. the unit whose text the quote actually is chose to cite it); a CONTRADICTED fact only the reviewer added, that the reviewed unit never cited, is the reviewer's own contextual gloss on an omission, not counter-evidence against the unit's claim, and belongs beside excluded_evidence_defect/absence_defect's reasoning rather than left unrefuted.
proposal.explicitly_not_proposed: NO removal or weakening of the CONTRADICTED-stands rule for the case it was built for (a finding whose quote asserts something a fact directly contradicts) - every case items 39/63/83 measured had the CONTRADICTED fact among the reviewed unit's own citations, so this scoping changes nothing for them. NO change to absence_defect or excluded_evidence_defect's own absent-list gating - a complementary fix (recognizing an omission-justification finding even when absent is left empty) is a separate, larger change this entry does not propose. Needs its own mutation test (a finding shaped exactly like F05, red before/green after) before landing, per loop-prompt.md section 6 rule 14.
